items.question: What is TallyNudge?
items.answer: A tally counter and clicker for iOS and Android. Package: com.zuki.apps.tallynudge.

items.question: Do I need an account?
items.answer: No. Counters stay on your device.

items.question: What is included for free?
items.answer: Up to 4 counters. Premium unlocks unlimited counters, history, volume buttons, and Home Screen widgets.

items.question: What is the Premium product ID?
items.answer: tallynudge_premium. Payments are processed by Apple or Google.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy for TallyNudge — Tally Counter & Clicker.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Zuki Apps handles information when you use TallyNudge and related pages at zukiapps.com/tally-nudge.

section1.title: 1. Who we are
section1.content: The data controller is Zuki Apps. Contact details are at the end of this Policy.
section1.content2: This Policy applies to the TallyNudge app and the legal pages we publish for the product.

section2.title: 2. Information we collect
section2.content: TallyNudge is designed to work on-device. We collect limited data to run the app and optional purchases.
items: Counter names, values, history, and Premium status stored on device
Feedback and support messages you send
Purchase records handled by Apple or Google — tokens only, not full card data

section3.title: 3. How we use information
section3.content2: We do not sell your personal information.

section4.title: 4. Advertising and tracking
section4.content: TallyNudge does not show ads in the current build. If ads are added later, this Policy will be updated.
section4.content2: You can limit tracking in system settings.

section5.title: 5. Storage and retention
section5.content: Counter data remains on device until you uninstall.
section5.content2: Ad and purchase partners retain data under their own policies.

section6.title: 6. Third-party services
section6.content: Apple App Store and Google Play Billing may process purchase data under their policies.
section6.content2: We do not sell your personal information.

section7.title: 7. Your rights and children
section7.content: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or object to certain processing. Contact us to exercise rights.
section7.content2: TallyNudge is a general-audience utility. It is not directed to children under 13.

section8.title: 8. Changes
section8.content: We may update this Policy from time to time. We will post the revised version with a new Last updated date.

q1.question: How many counters can I add?
q1.answer: Free includes 4 counters. Premium unlocks unlimited counters.

q2.question: Do widgets need an internet connection?
q2.answer: No. Counting runs on your device.

q3.question: How do I restore Premium?
q3.answer: Use Restore purchases in Settings after reinstall. Product ID: tallynudge_premium.

q4.question: Where are my counters stored?
q4.answer: On your device. Uninstalling the app deletes local counters and history.
